children: Canada specialty hardware distributor's Q3 revenue grew 12.6% yr/yr, driven by internal growth and acquisitions
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 23.3% yr/yr; net income up 22.4%
Company completed two acquisitions and launched C$15 mln Drummondville expansion project
Richelieu expects its C$15 mln Drummondville distribution-centre expansion to complete in spring 2027
PRICE INCREASES - Co said internal sales growth was mainly due to price increases to offset higher product and freight costs
RETAIL SALES - Initial deliveries to a major U.S. customer drove strong growth in retail and home improvement superstore sales
TARIFF REFUND - C$3 mln U.S. customs duty refund contributed to margin and earnings improvement
Q3 Net Earnings Attributable to shareholders
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction supplies & fixtures peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Richelieu Hardware Ltd. is C$38.75, about 9.6% above its October 6 closing price of C$35.37
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
